title: Consolidar o knowledge-layer: aposentar lessons.md + roteamento explicito + cam journal archive + audit advisory
description: Achado (inventario 2026-06-27, ciclo CAM-109/122): o cam tem 4 canais competindo pelo mesmo conteudo de licoes/conhecimento (lessons.md, journal.md Blockers/Follow-ups, patterns.md, memory/ auto-memory), e a redundancia ja cobrou preco: lessons.md esta MORTO desde 2026-06-15 (as ultimas ~70 issues CAM-53..122 foram registradas em journal+patterns+memory; lessons.md nao foi tocado). E o drift que o CLAUDE.md global alerta na etapa-dupla. DECISAO (operador, 2026-06-27): consolidar. ESCOPO: (1) Aposentar lessons.md: journal+patterns+memory ja o cobrem; arquivar e declarar oficialmente substituido nas instrucoes. (2) Roteamento explicito: tabela de 1 linha em scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md mapeando insight->arquivo (tecnico-reutilizavel->patterns.md; narrativa-de-ciclo->journal.md; licao-transversal-acionavel->memory auto-memory; decisao-hard-to-reverse->docs/adr; vocabulario->CONTEXT.md). Manter os 3 ativos (patterns/journal/memory tem leitor+timing distintos), NAO fundir. (3) CONTEXT.md: usar ou largar; hoje nunca foi materializado (CAM-118); ou o /cam-spec passa a escreve-lo de fato (writer deterministico) ou removemos a pretensao. (4) GC deterministico (nao LLM, nao cron-mutante): cam journal archive (a regra dos >50 entries do agent file vira comando, mesmo modulo do cam journal append do CAM-122); dedup advisory pro patterns.md. (5) Opcional: cam knowledge audit advisory + on-demand + deterministico-onde-der, que REPORTA candidatos a dedup/archive/promote no cycle-close, NUNCA muta autonomamente. REJEITADO explicitamente: cron-subagente mutante (overkill + arriscado: curadoria fria de arquivos canonicos sem o contexto que os gerou e o anti-pattern; a causa-raiz e roteamento ambiguo, nao falta de curador; o cam ja tem muita infra autonoma). CORRELACAO: passo curto na direcao do CAM-64 (Mulch knowledge central: typed pattern records + outcome-status + decay), pode ser coordenada/mergeada com ele. Pre-req parcial: CAM-122 (cam journal append) introduz o modulo cam journal onde o archive encaixa; CAM-118 (writer deterministico de CONTEXT.md/ADR) habilita o item 3. Prioridade P2.

spec.scope: Consolidate the knowledge-layer, DOC cluster only (cam journal archive is filed as CAM-125; audit advisory deferred). Three reconciliations, no new command code: (1) RETIRE lessons.md: rename to lessons.archive.md with a deprecation header (date 2026-06-27, superseded by journal.md + patterns.md + memory/, routing reference, planned future deletion), removing it from the agents write path. (2) ADD to scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md an explicit routing table (insight-type to canonical channel) plus a naming-convention rule and a location-convention rule. (3) RECONCILE CONTEXT.md: keep it as the active vocabulary channel but stop the instructions from claiming it auto-exists, pointing them at CAM-118 (the deterministic CONTEXT.md/ADR writer) as the population mechanism. Deliverable is docs (scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md) + the lessons.md rename only.
acceptanceCriteria: lessons.md is renamed to lessons.archive.md with a deprecation header naming the date, the superseding channels (journal.md/patterns.md/memory), the routing reference, and the planned future deletion; lessons.md no longer exists at the repo root [oracle: file-assert test ! -f lessons.md && test -f lessons.archive.md && grep -qi deprecated lessons.archive.md]

scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md contains an explicit routing table mapping each insight type to its canonical channel (patterns.md technical, journal.md cycle-narrative, memory cross-cutting, docs/adr decisions, CONTEXT.md vocabulary) [oracle: file-assert grep the routing rows in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md]

scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md documents the naming-convention rule: UPPERCASE.md is an external-convention entry-point (CLAUDE/CONTEXT/README/CHANGELOG/AGENTS), lowercase.md is a cam-internal artifact (journal/patterns) [oracle: file-assert grep the casing rule]
scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md documents the location-convention rule: scripts/cam/ is cam-harness knowledge, repo-root plus docs/ is the project domain-model [oracle: file-assert grep the location rule]

the routing records that the lessons.md retirement is a project-specific exception to the etapa-dupla convention in the global CLAUDE.md, which still holds for non-cam projects [oracle: file-assert grep the exception note]

CONTEXT.md is documented as an active vocabulary channel populated via the CAM-118 deterministic writer, not as an auto-existing file; the stale auto-exists claims in the scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md Domain Model Convention are reconciled to point at CAM-118 [oracle: file-assert grep CONTEXT.md references point to CAM-118]

no new command code is added (cam journal archive = CAM-125, CONTEXT.md/ADR writer = CAM-118 are out of scope); the diff touches only .md files plus the lessons.md rename [oracle: file-assert git diff --stat shows no src/ changes]
typecheck passes and the full gate spine is green [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: DOC-only scope: do NOT implement command code. cam journal archive is CAM-125; the CONTEXT.md/ADR deterministic writer is CAM-118. The deliverable is docs + the lessons.md rename.

Do NOT rename CLAUDE.md/CONTEXT.md/README.md/CHANGELOG.md: they are external-convention entry-points (Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md; domain-modeling/Pocock expects CONTEXT.md). The casing split is by design; document the rule, do not force a single casing.

Do NOT move journal.md/patterns.md out of scripts/cam/ or CONTEXT.md/docs/adr out of repo-root: the 2-namespace split (cam-harness vs project domain-model) is correct, especially for downstream cam init projects where CONTEXT.md/adr is the downstream project domain-model, not cam.
lessons.md retirement is a project-specific exception to the etapa-dupla in the global CLAUDE.md; do not touch the global file; the convention still holds for non-cam projects.
memory/ lives outside the repo; the routing references it as a channel but CAM-123 does not change how it is written (orchestrator-authored; a gated cam memory command, if ever, is separate).

scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (cam agent-instructions) is distinct from the repo-root CLAUDE.md (Bun/project instructions); the routing goes in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md. If templates/ mirrors it, update both copies + re-embed (dual-copy + embed rule).
domainTerms: knowledge-layer: the durable knowledge channels of a cam project (patterns.md, journal.md, memory/, docs/adr, CONTEXT.md), each with a distinct writer/reader/timing.
routing table: the insight-type to canonical-channel mapping in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md that resolves the 4-channels-competing drift.
naming convention: UPPERCASE.md is an external-convention entry-point (CLAUDE/CONTEXT/README/CHANGELOG/AGENTS); lowercase.md is a cam-internal artifact (journal/patterns).

location convention: scripts/cam/ is cam-harness knowledge; repo-root plus docs/ is the project domain-model (which belongs to the project, not the cam tool, hence the root for downstream cam init projects).
etapa-dupla exception: in cam-cli, lessons.md is retired in favor of journal/patterns/memory; the global etapa-dupla (lessons.md per project) still holds for non-cam projects.
